question: Would a site about <niche> plausibly publish a page about this topic for its readers? Borderline counts as no.
method: Blind pass by the agent that built the matcher (an independent subagent was not available): each distinct row of the top-20 lists was shown with only its label, its Wikidata description and the niche, in alphabetical order (no fit, reason or rank), and answered yes or no. The same answer applies wherever the row appears. Rule used: a species or a common-name group of birds counts yes; a genus, family or order shown by its scientific name, an extinct or legendary bird, and a film count no; a bread type that is not sourdough counts no.
